messages.subject: Re: Labling each point on a scatter plot
parts:
Hi Hayden,
You are looking for `geom_text`: http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.3.1/geom_text.html. Note how you can use the `vjust` and `hjust`arguments to move the labels around the points.

Best wishes,
Doug
